name: Setup Next.js Project & Design System
Description: Initialize Next.js App Router, configure TypeScript, and set up the shared design system base layout. Expectation: A clean modular base layout that is responsive on desktop and iPad Pro sizes.

name: Authentication & RBAC Middleware
Description: Implement secure login and strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) middleware for API routes and UI navigation. Expectation: Support agents and admins see different navigation items; unauthorized API calls are blocked.

name: User Management Data Table
Description: Build a server-side paginated data table to list users and organizations with advanced search (email/ID). Expectation: Sub-second response times even with large datasets.

name: User Actions (Suspend/Ban)
Description: Implement action modals for suspending, banning, or force-logging out users. Expectation: Must include confirmation dialogs and automatically trigger an audit log entry on success.

name: Financial Overrides Transaction Log
Description: Create a view to monitor the status of payment attempts (Pending/Failed/Successful). Expectation: Admins can quickly search for failed transactions related to a specific user.

name: Manual Grant & Revocation Actions
Description: Build the interface to manually grant 'Comp' access to paid events or revoke access. Expectation: Admin must be forced to fill out a 'Reason' text field before the action executes.

name: Meeting Health & Diagnostics Dashboard
Description: Create a real-time monitoring view showing active meetings and participant counts. Expectation: Clear visual indicators (green/yellow/red) for meeting health status.

name: WebRTC Stats & AI Job Monitoring
Description: Implement drill-down views for specific meeting WebRTC stats (packet loss/jitter) and backend AI job statuses (summaries). Expectation: Admins can export diagnostic snapshots for engineering.

name: Recording Metadata & Content Governance
Description: Build a media management table showing all platform recordings and storage footprint. Expectation: Admins can view metadata but cannot play private recordings without triggering 'Break Glass' protocol.

name: Privacy Deletion & AI Output Moderation
Description: Implement GDPR deletion actions for recordings and a moderation view for AI summary outputs attached to public replays. Expectation: Deletions are hard-deletes and strictly audited.

name: Analytics & KPI Dashboard
Description: Integrate charting libraries (e.g. Recharts) to display Free Users vs Paid Users and secondary metrics. Expectation: Charts handle empty data states gracefully and can be filtered by date/country.

name: Immutable Audit Log View
Description: Build a dedicated view accessible only to Super Admins showing every POST/PUT/DELETE action. Expectation: Table shows Timestamp, Admin ID, Action, Target ID, and IP. It cannot be edited.
